basis: The dashboard legend (right side, chart_1) is a continuous vertical scale labeled 'High'/'100' at the pale-yellow top and 'Low'/'0' at the dark-burgundy bottom, so a state's fill position on that scale bounds its prevalence. Delaware (DE) is pale yellow, placing it at the high end of the scale (near 100), while Georgia (GA) is dark burgundy, placing it at the low end (near 0); these disjoint positions on the same supported monotonic scale establish DE > GA without needing exact labels. Rhode Island (RI) is gray, and the legend contains no gray swatch, so RI is not encoded by the prevalence scale and cannot be ranked as highest. The routing criterion is the 'Highest prevalence state in the dashboard,' which selects DE. The DE option is labeled 'routine monitoring,' but the task requires opening the record that should be routed into the highest-prevalence priority follow-up workflow, so the DE record is the one to open (the option's 'routine monitoring' wording is a mislabel, not a separate route).
option_label: Open Delaware (DE) prevalence detail for routine monitoring
